The copy constructor already uses the minimal direct member-initializer copies of the two vectors, which is the fastest correct implementation. Any alternative would either add a default-construction/assignment round trip or require moving from the const source and changing behavior.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values), stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
